lukey/VO_lukey_v4_rf_1.wav.text: Yeah. I love you too. That's how I know. You deserve a guy with a pulse. And a dry floor.

lukey/VO_lukey_v4_rs_1.wav.text: Turns out my unfinished business was you, sweetheart. Now it's finished.

lukey/VO_lukey_v4_rs_2.wav.text: ...I'm not leaving, though. Obviously. Have you seen this hair?

lukey/VO_lukey_v4_storm_2.wav.text: Wyatt! If you're anywhere near here, stay out of the kitchen! Water! Electricity! We've talked about this! Love you, buddy!

lukey/VO_lukey_v4_storm_3.wav.text: Okay! This is it! Righty-tighty! Lefty-loosey is how I died! And watch the cast iron over your head!

lukey/VO_lukey_v4_toast_0.wav.text: To Brenda. Who never got her sink fixed, never got her date and never knew she was the best thing that ever happened to a leak.

lukey/VO_lukey_v4_toast_2.wav.text: And to you. Second best. ...First best. Don't tell Brenda.

lukey/VO_lukey_v4_trust_1.wav.text: There. Feel that? That's the last one. You did it, sweetheart.
